token_accounting.provider_semantics: OpenAI Chat Completions usage typically reports prompt_tokens (input, often including cached), completion_tokens (output), and optionally prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens. total_tokens is usually prompt_tokens + completion_tokens. Cached tokens are a subset of prompt_tokens — do NOT add cached on top of prompt_tokens. Billable cost may treat cached tokens at a reduced rate; this harness reports counts separately and does not invent dollar conversions.

pair_aggregation.note: Primary exact reductions only include SUCCESS+comparable+allow_exact_token_reduction pairs. Failures and rejects are retained.

layered_report.claim_policy: EXACT MEASURED REDUCTION only when both runs succeed, validate_layer3_pair is comparable, OverHaust context inclusion is proven, and provider totals exist on both sides.
